quizName:
Hardest Questions in Oregon
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: If someone is driving aggressively behind you, what should you do?

options.text: Stare at the driver as they pass you.
Speed up while they are passing you.

questions.explanation: If an aggressive driver is behind you, move out of their way. Do not make eye contact with them. Do not speed up or challenge them, as this may make them angrier and more dangerous.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that when turning left on a green light, they must yield to oncoming traffic. You may complete the turn when it is safe.

questions.question: If you are in a serious car crash, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Stop your vehicle if possible and move it off the road. Check for injuries and call 911 if needed. Report the crash to police if there is an injury, death, or more than $1,000 in property damage.

questions.question: When driving on highways, you should:

options.text: Be ready to react to hazards.

questions.explanation: Stay alert on highways and be ready to react to unexpected hazards. Keep your eyes moving and do not look at one thing for too long to avoid highway hypnosis.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means that action is not allowed. Right turns are prohibited where this sign is posted.

questions.question: When you approach railroad tracks, what should you do?

options.text: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
Speed up to cross before the gate lowers.
Try to drive around a lowered gate.
Ignore how many tracks there are.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: When approaching railroad tracks, look and listen for trains. Slow down and be ready to stop for trains or other vehicles on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to respond to red, yellow, and green lights and to watch for other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign warns you of a steep hill ahead. Adjust your speed to avoid brake damage or crashes.

questions.question: When stopped for a traffic violation or equipment check, what documents must you show?
questions.explanation: You must carry and show your driver's license, proof of registration, and proof of insurance when driving. Have all three documents ready when stopped.

questions.question: What could cause you to crash?

options.text: Taking your eyes off the road
Taking your hands off the wheel
Taking your attention away from driving

questions.explanation: Anything that takes your attention away from driving, your eyes off the road, or your hands off the wheel is a distraction and can cause a crash.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers what they must do. It means you cannot make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: When turning or changing lanes, you must:

options.text: Always signal, even if no other cars are nearby.
Signal only if other cars are nearby.
Signal only when driving at night.
Signal only in heavy traffic at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always signal, even if no other cars are nearby.
questions.explanation: Always signal before changing lanes, turning, or pulling away from the curb. This is the law. Do not skip signaling, even if you see no other cars.

questions.question: What can cause distracted driving?

options.text: Talking or texting on a phone.
Changing the radio station or CD.

questions.explanation: Drivers must make many decisions while driving. Any activity that takes your attention away from the road is dangerous. Keep your focus on driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means that action is prohibited. You cannot make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: When a school bus stops with its stop arm extended, you should:

options.text: Stop completely and wait until the arm is raised.
Honk your horn and pass on the left side.
Drive on when you think children are done leaving.
Pass the bus before its door opens.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and wait until the arm is raised.
questions.explanation: When a school bus has its stop arm out, you must come to a complete stop. Do not move until the arm is lowered.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot drive in this direction.

questions.question: You had a stressful incident at work and feel angry. What should you do before driving home?

options.text: Play loud music so you won't think about it.
Drive fast on the highway to release stress.
Take a few minutes to calm down before driving.
Stop for drinks before driving home.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down before driving.
questions.explanation: If you are upset or angry, wait until you feel calm before driving. Driving while upset puts you and others at risk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers what they must do. It means you cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This eight-sided sign means you must stop. Check for traffic and other hazards before proceeding safely.

questions.question: Why is night driving more difficult than day driving?

options.text: You cannot see as well in the dark.
It rains more often at night.
You are more likely to see motorcycles at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot see as well in the dark.
questions.explanation: At night, your vision is limited. Use your headlights and drive slowly so you can stop if something appears in your path.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: How can alcoholic beverages affect you?

options.text: It gives you a false sense of confidence.

questions.explanation: Alcohol affects the parts of your brain that control judgment and self-control. It slows your reaction time, coordination, and balance. It also impairs your vision and ability to judge distance.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers the direction they must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means that left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does alcohol cause?
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol impairs your vision, judgment, concentration, and coordination.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This sign alerts drivers that bicycles may cross the road in this area.

questions.question: What can impair a person's ability to drive?
questions.explanation: Safe driving depends on being in good physical condition. Alcohol, drugs, and drowsiness can all impair your ability to drive.

questions.question: When should you slow down?

options.text: When the road is wet or slippery.

questions.explanation: You should slow down on narrow or winding roads, near intersections, near railroad crossings, on hills, in sharp or blind curves, near pedestrians or hazards, and when roads are wet or slippery.

questions.question: On a freeway, you missed your turn or exit. What should you do?

options.text: Make the turn quickly from your lane of travel.
Continue driving until you reach the next turn, exit, or other location where you can safely turn around.
Signal other drivers to stop so you can turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue driving until you reach the next turn, exit, or other location where you can safely turn around.
questions.explanation: If you miss your turn or exit, do not back up. Go to the next turn or exit where you can safely turn around. Backing up on a shoulder or freeway is illegal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This circular sign warns drivers about a railroad crossing ahead. Watch for trains and be ready to stop.

questions.question: If you miss your freeway exit, what should you do?

options.text: Make a U-turn through the median.
Pull onto the shoulder and back your car to the exit.
Flag down a police officer for an escort back to your exit.

questions.explanation: Take the next exit. Never stop, back up, or cross the median on a freeway. These actions are illegal and dangerous.

questions.question: What should you do when you encounter an aggressive driver?

options.text: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
Cut them off to slow them down.
Make sure they know you disapprove of their behavior.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
questions.explanation: Stay calm and create distance between your vehicle and theirs. Slow down and let them pass. Do not make eye contact or make gestures.

questions.question: You are borrowing an unfamiliar vehicle from a friend. What should you do?

options.text: Not put too much thought into it because all vehicles are the same.
Hide from your friend that you are unfamiliar with the vehicle.
Disregard any obvious defects to avoid embarrassing your friend.
Spend a few minutes learning where the controls are and how they work before you drive.

questions.correctAnswerText: Spend a few minutes learning where the controls are and how they work before you drive.
questions.explanation: Before driving, learn the location and operation of the turn signals, hazard lights, headlights, windshield wipers, brakes, gear selector, and horn. Fix any problems before driving.

questions.question: What should you do before turning?
questions.explanation: Turn on your signal 3 to 4 seconds before you turn. This tells other drivers your plan.
